'''Marrow's Moor''' was a location at which the [[Battle of Gligger]] was fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the confrontation, 563 [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer/Legends|LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] in the at Marrow's Moor while trying to clear [[Mine/Legends|mines]].
